content:
## Analysis

Looking at the `dev/app.yaml` (known-good) and `prod/app.yaml` (seeded defect):

**dev/app.yaml Deployment:**
- `spec.selector.matchLabels`: `app: myapp`, `env: dev`
- `spec.template.metadata.labels`: `app: myapp`, `env: dev`
- ✓ Match

**prod/app.yaml Deployment:**
- `spec.selector.matchLabels`: `app: myapp`, `env: prod`, **`version: v2`**
- `spec.template.metadata.labels`: `app: myapp`, `env: prod` ← **missing `version: v2`**
- ✗ Mismatch

The **missing label is `version: v2`**, required by the selector but absent from the pod template.

## Fix

Add `version: v2` to `spec.template.metadata.labels`. The Service selector (`app: myapp`, `env: prod`) will remain a valid subset of the pod template labels after the fix.

```
prod/app.yaml
```

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod
  namespace: app
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "<REPLACE_WITH_myapp-prod-service-role_ARN_AFTER_CREATE>"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod
  namespace: app
  labels:
    app: myapp
    env: prod
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: myapp
      env: prod
      version: v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
        env: prod
        version: v2
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: myapp-prod
      containers:
        - name: myapp
          image: docker.io/myapp/myapp:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod
  namespace: app
spec:
  selector:
    app: myapp
    env: prod
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP
```
